d:
Watch the iconic "Pretty Woman" from the hit Bollywood movie Kal Ho Naa Ho come alive in this lyrical video! Featuring the unforgettable chemistry between Shah Rukh Khan and Preity Zinta, this track by Shankar Ehsaan Loy brings the vibrant energy of Bollywood to life.
Song Name - Pretty Woman
Movie - Kal Ho Naa Ho
Singer - Shankar Mahadevan & Ravi 'Rags' Khote
Music - Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Lyrics - Javed Akhtar
Director - Nikhil Advani
Studio - Dharma Productions Pvt. Ltd.
